cohort: 639 participants in a birth cohort in metropolitan Detroit, Michigan
finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with higher odds of obesity at age 2 years in children of African American mothers, but not in children of non-African American mothers.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with a significantly higher odds of obesity at age 2 years in children of African American mothers, but not in children of non-African American mothers.
